trial_tbl <- trial_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    NEPC_AVPC_Accrual_Requirement = case_when(
      grepl("NCT04848337", NCT) ~ "Yes (NEPC features required)",
      grepl("NCT01799278", NCT) ~ "Yes (NE-enriched eligibility required)",
      grepl("NCT07024277", NCT) ~ "Yes (metastatic NEPC required)",
      grepl("NCT04702737", NCT) ~ "Yes (de novo/t-NEPC required)",
      grepl("NCT04709276", NCT) ~ "Yes (histologic NEPC/small-cell OR AVPC criteria)",
      grepl("NCT03179410", NCT) ~ "Yes (histologic NEPC/small-cell OR AVPC criteria)",
      grepl("NCT03263650", NCT) ~ "AVPC-enriched (>=1 AVPC criterion required)",
      grepl("NCT04592237", NCT) ~ "AVPC-enriched (protocol-defined AVPC criteria)",
      grepl("NCT07218666", NCT) ~ "Yes (AVPC required)",
      grepl("NCT06470243", NCT) ~ "No (all mCRPC eligible; AV signature for stratification)",
      grepl("NCT01505868", NCT) ~ "No (mCRPC eligible), with anaplastic/small-cell subgroup allowed",
      grepl("NCT03582475", NCT) ~ "Yes (small-cell/neuroendocrine histology required)",
      grepl("NCT04388852", NCT) ~ "AVPC-enriched (AV molecular signature required in prostate cohort)",
      grepl("NCT05058651", NCT) ~ "Not CRPC-based (extrapulmonary NEC trial)",
      grepl("NCT06464068", NCT) ~ "Not CRPC-based (extrapulmonary small-cell trial)",
      grepl("NCT02487095", NCT) ~ "Not CRPC-based (small-cell including extrapulmonary cohorts)",
      grepl("NCT03896503", NCT) ~ "Not CRPC-based (small-cell including extrapulmonary cohorts)",
      grepl("NCT05312671", NCT) ~ "Not CRPC-based (bladder small-cell/NE trial)",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  relocate(NEPC_AVPC_Accrual_Requirement, .after = Phase_Status)

kable(
  trial_tbl,
  align = "l",
  escape = FALSE,
  col.names = c(
    "Stratum",
    "Study",
    "NCT",
    "Sites (n)",
    "Phase / status",
    "NEPC/AVPC required for accrual",
    "Accrual state",
    "Sample size (planned/actual)",
    "Primary endpoint",
    "Tumor-specific inclusion (condensed)",
    "Notes"
  )
)

## Appendix: Tumor-Specific Inclusion Criteria (Exact, Mixed CRPC/NEPC Trials)

```{r mixed-crpc-nepc-criteria-appendix}
mixed_criteria_tbl <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Study, ~NCT, ~NEPC_AVPC_Required_for_Accrual, ~Tumor_Specific_Inclusion_Criteria_Exact,
  "CHAMP",
  "[NCT04709276](https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT04709276)",
  "Yes",
  "Neuroendocrine-like prostate cancer required: either (1) histologically proven small-cell/intermediate atypical/mixed adenocarcinoma-NE histology, OR (2) adenocarcinoma with AV features (e.g., visceral metastases, low-PSA bulky/high-volume disease, short interval to CRPC, TP53/RB1/PTEN 2-of-3 alterations, NE marker positivity).",
  "PICK-NEPC",
  "[NCT03179410](https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT03179410)",
  "Yes",
  "Neuroendocrine-like phenotype required: either histologic small-cell/NEPC/mixed histology OR adenocarcinoma with AV clinical features (e.g., liver metastases, low-PSA bulky progression, elevated LDH after AR pathway therapy progression).",
  "Olaparib maintenance after cabazitaxel-carboplatin in AVPC",
  "[NCT03263650](https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT03263650)",
  "Yes (AVPC-enriched)",
  "Required >=1 AVPC criterion: histologic small-cell prostate carcinoma, exclusive visceral metastases, lytic bone metastases, bulky nodal/pelvic mass, low-PSA plus high-volume bone disease, elevated LDH/CEA, short interval to CRPC, or >=2 alterations among TP53/RB1/PTEN.",
  "Platinum-taxane-cetrelimab induction then niraparib +/- cetrelimab",
  "[NCT04592237](https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT04592237)",
  "Yes (AVPC-enriched)",
  "Required metastatic AVPC features including small-cell option and/or AV molecular criteria (including TP53/RB1/PTEN-based aberrancy by CLIA testing / IHC / sequencing).",
  "Cabazitaxel +/- carboplatin (Phase I/II)",
  "[NCT01505868](https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT01505868)",
  "No (all mCRPC eligible; AV/anaplastic subgroup allowed)",
  "Histologic prostate adenocarcinoma eligible broadly; additional 'anaplastic' subgroup included histologic small-cell disease or aggressive clinical features (exclusive visceral disease, lytic metastases, bulky mass, low-PSA/high-volume phenotype, elevated LDH/CEA, short interval to CRPC).",
  "Pembrolizumab + platinum in GU small-cell/NE cancers",
  "[NCT03582475](https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT03582475)",
  "Yes",
  "Required histologically confirmed small-cell/neuroendocrine histology of bladder/urethra/upper urinary tract OR primary small-cell/neuroendocrine prostate cancer (pure or mixed small-cell/NE allowed).",
  "DS3201 + ipilimumab basket (prostate cohort)",
  "[NCT04388852](https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT04388852)",
  "Yes (prostate cohort AVPC molecular-enriched)",
  "Prostate cohort required CRPC plus AVPC molecular signature with >=2 abnormalities among TP53/RB1/PTEN; variant histologies including small-cell/neuroendocrine prostate carcinoma were explicitly permitted."
)

kable(
  mixed_criteria_tbl,
  align = "l",
  escape = FALSE,
  col.names = c(
    "Study",
    "NCT",
    "NEPC/AVPC required for accrual",
    "Tumor-specific inclusion criteria (exact, condensed)"
  )
)
```
